Title: Highlights & Features of The All New ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 & 2080 Ti | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/us/news/highlights-features-all-new-zotac-gaming-geforce-rtx-2080-2080-ti
Published: 2018-08-20T18:14:51.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
If you're looking for the absolute best, the new king of performance is the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® RTX 2080 Ti. This model also comes equipped with three fans, all individually controlled using AFC and sporting the new physical fan design for better airflow, just like the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® RTX 2080 AMP!. 

The 2080 Ti heatsink also gets optimized with up to five 8mm heatpipes, has a metal backplate, and features RGB lighting controlled with ZOTAC SPECTRA via the new, refined ZOTAC FIRESTORM app coming soon. This card is the same size as the 2080 AMP! model but more powerful, boasting an impressive 11GB GDDR6 352-bit memory compared to the AMP!’s 8GB GDDR6 256-bit memory. 

The best of both come together in our most powerful card yet: The current flaghip of the ZOTAC GAMING 20-series lineup, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 Ti AMP!. This card carries the same features as our 2080 AMP! card including three individually controlled fans with the new innovative design, optimized heatsink, metal backplate, and RGB lighting. 

This variant has a slight edge; measuring 12.13 inches long, this card comes overclocked out of the box with 11GB GDDR6 352-bit memory. If you’re looking for the best upgrade on the market from your current card, you’ve found your next GPU. Currently, it does not get any better than this.
